title: Australian Parliament Registers of Interests
subtitle: Every interest disclosed by federal MPs and senators, 2010 to now
description: See README.md: one row per disclosed item, with member, party and standardised entity.

fields.name: item_id
fields.description: Stable id of the disclosed item (sha1 of the document hash and the item's content; see docs/v2/loading.md).

fields.name: chamber
fields.description: `house` (House of Representatives) or `senate`.

fields.name: parliament
fields.description: Parliament number (43 = 2010-2013 … 48 = 2025-).

fields.name: member_id
fields.description: Stable member id (slug of the member's name, e.g. `tony_abbott`); the same person keeps one id across parliaments and chambers.

fields.name: member_name
fields.description: Member's full name.

fields.name: party
fields.description: Member's party for this parliament (start of term).

fields.name: political_bloc
fields.description: `Labor`, `Coalition` or `Crossbench`, derived from party.

fields.name: electorate_or_state
fields.description: House: electorate. Senate: state or territory.

fields.name: statement_date
fields.description: Date of the member's initial statement (YYYY-MM-DD), where printed.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Register section number (1-14, the House form's numbering; Senate categories are mapped onto it).

fields.name: subsection
fields.description: Sub-part of the section where the form has one (`2(i)` family trusts, `2(ii)` other trusts), else empty.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Section name: Shareholding, Trust, Real estate, Directorship, Partnership, Liability, Bond/debenture, Account, Other asset, Income, Gift, Sponsored travel/hospitality, Membership, Other interest.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Whose interest it is: `self`, `spouse`, `dependent_child` or `unknown`.

fields.name: entity_name_as_printed
fields.description: The company, organisation, trust or person the item names, as printed. Empty when the item names no entity (e.g. a house address).

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: Standardised entity id; items naming the same organisation in different spellings share it. Empty for no entity or a generic term (e.g. `family trust`).

fields.name: entity_name
fields.description: Canonical name of the standardised entity.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: Entity type (listed_company, private_company, bank_or_financial, trust_or_fund, association_or_ngo, sporting_body, government_body, political_party, union, airline, media_or_entertainment, education, person, other). Empty for one-off (singleton) entities.

fields.name: entity_asx_code
fields.description: ASX ticker when the entity is a listed company we matched.

fields.name: entity_match_method
fields.description: How the name was standardised: `curated` (hand table), `asx` (ASX listed-companies snapshot), `llm` (LLM grouping of variants), `singleton` (one-off name, its own entity) or `generic` (generic term, no entity).

fields.name: description
fields.description: The item as printed on the form (the full cell text).

fields.name: location
fields.description: Location, where the form gives one (real estate, travel).

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: Purpose, where the form gives one (real estate, liabilities).

fields.name: is_alteration
fields.description: 1 if the item comes from a later Notification of Alteration, 0 if from the initial statement.

fields.name: change_type
fields.description: `initial`, `added`, `removed`, `varied` or `unknown`.

fields.name: lodged_date
fields.description: Date the statement or alteration was lodged (YYYY-MM-DD; see date_precision).

fields.name: date_precision
fields.description: `day`, `month` (day set to 01) or `unknown` (no date printed; lodged_date empty).

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page of the source PDF the item is on (1-based). Senate items: 1.

fields.name: extraction_confidence
fields.description: Extractor's confidence in the item: `high`, `medium` or `low` (low/medium = hard-to-read scan or ambiguous layout).

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Source document path in the repository (House PDF, or the Senate API JSON payload).

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the source document.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Where the source document was downloaded from (APH).

fields.name: extraction_source
fields.description: `gemini-api` (LLM transcription of the PDF) or `senate-json` (Senate interests API, no LLM).

fields.name: extraction_model
fields.description: Model(s) that transcribed the PDF; `a+b` means model b handled pages model a refused.
